name: libxslt transformation engine
description: The XSLT transformation engine in libxslt processes XML documents using XSLT stylesheets. The logic involves two main phases: parsing the stylesheet into an internal representation (compiled stylesheet) and then applying this stylesheet to a source XML document. The parsing phase handles template compilation, attribute set resolution, and namespace processing. The transformation phase manages the transformation context, evaluates XPath expressions, executes instructions (like xsl:apply-templates, xsl:call-template), and generates the result document. This logic group covers the core engine including the recursive node processing and instruction execution.
